On weekends, the routine shifts to a later start and more relaxed activities, such as a late lunch/early dinner and phone use in the bedroom at night.

The weekend pattern (no morning departure, late meal, phone in bedroom) was observed on Saturday and Sunday. The work_lanyard on Monday further confirms a professional identity. The bowl at sink at 07:46 suggests a breakfast routine before departure.
